summary: Owner references resolve to canonical owning glossary paths.
Adopted IDs remain present and replacements are explicit.
Root GLOSSARY.md links resolve with or without ./ prefixes.
Expected bytes preserve concurrent working-tree edits.
Null glossary configuration disables the manifest without an untyped failure.
Ranking tests assert relevant order and unequal positive scores.
A repository-wide lock serializes validation and glossary replacement.
Invalid Git filenames and malformed tree records return RepositoryError.
Tracked text uses one strict cat-file batch read.
